text:
Type: perforated metal table lamp
Use: decorative mood light on a side table, a shelf or a bedside table; living room, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: white powder-coated steel shade with a cut-out pattern, white cord
Colors: white, warm glow through the cut-outs
Shape: tall tapered cone with rows of looped hairpin cut-outs, rests on four short feet, compact and upright, light visual weight
Feel: playful, graphic, soft, cozy
Goes with: white walls, light wood, pastel accents; Scandinavian, modern or contemporary rooms

product.name: KAJUTA
product.description: Light bulb sold separately. IKEA recommends LED bulb E14 200 lumen chandelier clear. View more product information Creates a decorative light pattern in the room when the light shines through the perforated shade.
